notes.title: Patch note 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch note 1.0.1[/h1]

As you may know today was release day! We received some bug reports (thank you very much for that!) so here are the fixes!

[list]
[*] The big tree in the level where crystals are introduced doesn't float anymore
[*] The debug mode has been removed
[*] The timer is now incrementing properly
[*] Some decorations were moved to the right place
[/list]

[h2]Sidenote[/h2]
We had a lot of feedbacks about the level that's at 56% of the game (see the next screenshot).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41518106/ee0dc083c7d542b2979e2e438861c1b44ccefb9d.png[/img]

It seems that players are having a hard time going through this level. We'll wait a few days, and if people are still stuck there, we will make it a bit easier.

notes.title: Release planned for the 25th of February
notes.content:
[h1]Release post-poned to the 25th of February[/h1]

First I wanted to say thank you to everybody who added Alien Shepherd to their Wishlist. It's great to see that some people are waiting for us to release the game !

We planned the game release for the 31st of January and we will post-pone it to the 25th of February.

This is the first game of the team, and we are working hard to release a game that we can be proud of.

To give you an idea of what we did these last weeks, here's a non-exhaustive list:

* Create a storyboard for an introduction animation
* Design 56 different levels
* Decorate 13 of them by hand

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41518106/6adce3476744f1b17b100b8febadf3a4eb209086.jpg[/img]

* Add light sources
* Update all screenshots / trailer on the steam page
* Create a twitter account ([url=https://twitter.com/AlienShepherd]https://twitter.com/AlienShepherd[/url])
* Translate the game in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portugese and English
* Add a new biome

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41518106/629981b08a9d89897f85f35cd4365df09a1a0051.jpg[/img]

* Add images for the control inputs (keyboard keys and gamepad buttons)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41518106/64cc6140c232535a034e12daa22a4e4db407732f.png[/img]

And a lot of other things that I forgot about!
